fusions.name: Holed Below the Waterline
fusions.desc: Drags a reef edge along the target for 26 damage that ignores armour, leaving it [Bleeding] for 4 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Fouled Bottom
fusions.desc: Growth spreads from you onto every enemy within 2 tiles, dealing 3 damage with a 40% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Encrusted Strakes
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 20% for 12 seconds, and you carry 10% water resistance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Barnacle Ward
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a layer builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 5% of your maximum health per layer. Unfed, a layer fades every 10 seconds.
